title: Categorical Variable Encoding Specification for MoS2 Contact ML

contact_architecture.rationale: Transferred vdW contacts suppress Fermi-level pinning; edge contacts provide 1D covalent orbital overlap.

deposition_method.rationale: Mechanical transfer eliminates high-energy kinetic bombardment and defect creation.

recommended_strategy: OneHotEncoder with handle_unknown='ignore' inside Pipeline to guarantee zero data leakage
leakage_safeguards: Encoders must only be fitted on training fold indices
Unseen test categories must encode to zero-vectors rather than throwing errors
